scenes.title: Intro
scenes.text: This is {brand}. Notes, tasks, and your whole day, in one private app.

scenes.title: Quick capture
scenes.text: Type it once. Date, priority, project. Done. Then drag it onto your day.

scenes.title: Inbox
scenes.text: Paste a link, drop a thought. Then triage it: the link becomes a note, the thought a task. Inbox zero.

scenes.title: Notes
scenes.text: Write fast. Slash for anything, brackets to link your ideas.

scenes.title: Tasks in notes
scenes.text: And any line becomes a task, right where you wrote it.

scenes.title: Today
scenes.text: Today shows what matters. Check it off.

scenes.title: AI
scenes.text: Ask AI about your week. It reads your vault and answers in seconds.

scenes.title: CLI and agents
scenes.text: Built for agents too. A CLI and MCP tools, writing straight into your vault.

scenes.title: Projects and boards
scenes.text: Projects pull it all together. Drag a card, move it forward.

scenes.title: Journal and calendar
scenes.text: Every day gets a journal page, right next to your calendar.

scenes.title: Search and graph
scenes.text: Find anything in a keystroke. Then see how it all connects.

scenes.title: Canvas
scenes.text: Think visually. Put your real notes and tasks on a canvas, and connect them.

scenes.title: Sync and privacy
scenes.text: Synced across your devices, and end to end encrypted. Only you can read it.
